source_read: https://wimpy-uk.s3-eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/static/Nutrition%20Guide.pdf (downloaded fresh 2026-10-08, Last-Modified 27 Apr 2026; the S3 host has no robots.txt: it answers 403 like any missing key, so nothing is disallowed)
notes: Independent read: numbers from pdftotext -bbox word positions (9 columns calibrated per page), allergens by sampling the rendered 300 dpi page at each row/column dot (red = contains, amber and dark brown = the two may-contain kinds) instead of the script's SVG shapes; 183 of 183 published rows matched exactly on all nine nutrients plus every contains/may/cereal mark (Iced Coffee's label could not be matched automatically and was checked by hand); crops rendered and read by eye. No kJ/kcal, saturates, sugars or energy contradictions in the source rows, no name-vs-allergen contradictions beyond the three marked ok. Left as printed: Sausage Patty and Breakfast Sausage differ on gluten (guide marks gluten for Breakfast Sausage only).
